detail.longDescription: Question for anyone who might know: what gender choices should a # dating app offer? Is man/woman better than male/female? What other options should there be? The idea is to have a "I am a..." single choice field and then a multiple choice "I'm looking for..." list of checkboxes. Anything else I should take into account? # webdev # genders # genderequality # inclusivity # inclusivedesign
